name: bevy
description: Bevy (Rust ECS engine) skill carrying only what changed in 0.17–0.20 and still gets written the old way: buffered events renamed to messages, resources stored as entities (IsResource and broad-query panics), On<Add<T>> lifecycle observers, flattened pointer events, set_if_different, Name lifetimes, iter_many results, Mesh2d sprites and weakly ordered built-in sets. Reads Cargo.lock before advising.
